svg.title: results uav
svg.desc: Four panels show recorded Mill 19 AUC at 5, 10 and 20 degrees, median position error in normalized units on a log scale, median rotation error, and CPU mapping time. All configurations register 120 images in one model, but learned has median rotation error 64.33 degrees and 27 cameras over 170 degrees. Normalized units are not metres and feature counts differ.

cc:Work.dc:description: Four panels show recorded Mill 19 AUC at 5, 10 and 20 degrees, median position error in normalized units on a log scale, median rotation error, and CPU mapping time. All configurations register 120 images in one model, but learned has median rotation error 64.33 degrees and 27 cameras over 170 degrees. Normalized units are not metres and feature counts differ.

g.text: The shortlist SIFT arm reports 7592 keypoints/image versus ALIKED’s 4600. Front-end CPU/GPU timings are omitted.
